SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	CREATE VIEW v DEFAULT COLLATION UNICODE AS SELECT 'a'
READ	SELECT * FROM v
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	CREATE VIEW v DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_LCASE AS SELECT 'a' AS c1
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c1 = 'A'
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t (c1 STRING COLLATE UTF8_LCASE)
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('a'), ('A')
DDL	CREATE VIEW v DEFAULT COLLATION SR_AI_CI AS SELECT c1 FROM t WHERE 'ć' = 'č'
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c1 = 'A'
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t (c1 STRING COLLATE UTF8_LCASE)
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('ć'), ('č')
DDL	CREATE VIEW v DEFAULT COLLATION UNICODE AS SELECT CAST(c1 AS STRING COLLATE SR_AI) FROM t
READ	SELECT DISTINCT COLLATION(c1) FROM v
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c1 = 'c'
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t (c1 STRING COLLATE UTF8_LCASE)
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('ć'), ('č')
DDL	CREATE VIEW v DEFAULT COLLATION UNICODE AS SELECT CAST(c1 AS STRING COLLATE SR_AI) FROM t
READ	SELECT DISTINCT COLLATION(c1) FROM v
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c1 = 'c'
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	CREATE VIEW v DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_LCASE
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c1 = 'A'
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c2 = 'a'
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c2 = 'b'
READ	SELECT * FROM v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t (c1 STRING, c2 STRING COLLATE UTF8_LCASE)
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('a', 'a'), ('A', 'A'), ('b', 'b')
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v DEFAULT COLLATION sr_ci_ai AS SELECT *, 'ć' AS c3 FROM t
READ	SELECT DISTINCT COLLATION(c1) FROM v
READ	SELECT DISTINCT COLLATION(c2) FROM v
READ	SELECT DISTINCT COLLATION(c3) FROM v
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c1 = 'A'
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c2 = 'a'
READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c3 = 'Č'
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	CREATE VIEW v DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_LCASE AS SELECT 1
DDL	ALTER VIEW v AS SELECT 'a' AS c1, 'b' AS c2
READ	SELECT COLLATION(c1) FROM v
READ	SELECT COLLATION(c2) FROM v
DDL	ALTER VIEW v AS SELECT 'c' AS c3 WHERE 'a' = 'A'
READ	SELECT COLLATION(c3) FROM v
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t (c1 STRING COLLATE UTF8_LCASE, c2 STRING, c3 INT)
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('a', 'b', 1)
DDL	CREATE VIEW v DEFAULT COLLATION sr_AI_CI AS SELECT 'a' AS c1
DDL	ALTER VIEW v AS
READ	SELECT COLLATION(c4) FROM v
READ	SELECT COLLATION(c5) FROM v
READ	SELECT c5 FROM v

SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW v DEFAULT COLLATION UNICODE AS SELECT 'a'
READ	SELECT * FROM v

READ	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE c3 = 'Č'

READ	SELECT COLLATION(c1) FROM v
READ	SELECT COLLATION(c2) FROM v
DDL	ALTER VIEW v AS SELECT 'c' AS c3 WHERE 'a' = 'A'
READ	SELECT COLLATION(c3) FROM v

WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('a', 'b', 1)
